name: NEMA 17 bipolar stepper motor (17HS4401-style, 1.7 A)
description: 42 x 42 mm bipolar stepper, 1.8 degree steps, about 0.4 N.m holding torque. Needs a stepper driver (A4988 / DRV8825).
notes: Rated 1.7 A per phase, about 1.5 Ohm and 2.8 mH per coil (17HS4401). Set the driver current limit at or below the rating; you rarely need the full rating.
Wire colours and connector order vary a lot between makers. Find the coil pairs with a multimeter: the two wires of one coil read a few ohms between them.
Swapping the two wires of ONE coil reverses the direction; mixing wires of different coils makes it buzz without turning.
Body length (and current) varies: 34, 40, 48 mm bodies are all called NEMA 17.

keepout.note: 22 mm centring boss on the shaft face

geometry.note: NEMA 17 standard face: 42.3 mm square, M3 holes on a 31 mm square, 22 mm boss, 5 mm shaft. Holes and shaft are on the front face (top view here).

mechanical.source: 17HS4401 datasheet: 0.4 N·m holding. Running torque falls with speed; 50 % of holding is used as the usable torque at moderate speed.
